sermon.title: Share Service— March 6, 2022
sermon.speaker: Various (share service)
sermon.summary: A sharing service: a song, testimonies from members online and in the room, an update on a new school in Texas, Isaac as an example not to compare, the gifts of one Spirit, and Paul caring for the jailer.
sermon.transcript_source: This transcript comes from YouTube’s automatic English captions, which supply the timing and the words. Punctuation, capitalization and paragraphing were added from the speaker’s pauses and then corrected by hand, and obvious caption errors (names, Bible references) were fixed; his wording was not rewritten. “[unclear]” marks a word or name that was not clear. Editor notes: Sharing begins at 23:21 after worship.

You know. When you compare Isaac to Abraham and Jacob as far as the stories go it doesn’t really see it didn’t really stick out to me in my head that Isaac talked to God a lot compared to Abraham and Jacob so I had to go back through and I had to read the story of Isaac and there.

Are a few verses where God does talk to him like tells him you know don’t go to Egypt don’t like leave where you’re at and or um when Rebekah his wife was couldn’t wasn’t having any children Isaac did pray and ask God to you know bless her and things like that so Isaac did have interactions with God but at the same time. The prophecy about Jacob being the second boy Isaac sorry Isaac’s sons Esau and Jacob Esau they’re twins if you don’t know Esau was born first technically but Jacob was coming out right after him and the prophecy that Rebekah got before they were born was that Jacob would rule over the first Esau the firstborn and I wonder like maybe God didn’t tell Isaac that because Isaac.

chunks.section_question: How do the gifts of the Spirit fit?
chunks.short_answer: Diversities of gifts but the same Spirit; the parts that seem less honorable receive greater honor.
chunks.text:
And it’s just another example where Isaac is included in this it just reminds me that. As a human being. It’s my tendency to compare. Someone to someone else. And to think oh they’re not the same in this regard and Isaac wasn’t the same he didn’t have the same. Exact. Interactions with God like Abraham and Jacob but he still was part of the plan God still used him as a father of Jacob and Esau and carried on the promise to Jacob and we all know you know Jacob became Israel and had his many sons. And it also reminds me. To well before I summarize it let me go to this scripture in first Corinthians 12:4.

We’re talking about the gifts of the spirit now this is what the author’s talking about in this scripture and he says there are diversities of gifts but the same spirit there are differences of ministries but the same Lord and there are diversities of activities but it is the same God who works all in all. But the manifestation of the spirit is given to each one for the prophet of all for to one is given the word of wisdom through the spirit another knowledge another gifts of healing another working of miracles to another prophecy. To another discerning of spirits to another different kinds of tongues and to another the interpretation of tongues he’s talking about how many ways God expresses his spirit through us through different people he gives different gifts or maybe.

One person might have multiple but it’s not doesn’t necessarily mean that God is going to treat this person less than the other person. But one in the same spirit we’re still in the same chapter but one in the same spirit works all these things distributing to each one individually as he wills for as the body. Is one and has many members but all the members of that body of that one body being many are one body so also is Christ for by one spirit we were all baptized into one body whether Jews or greeks whether slaves are free and have all been made to drink into one spirit for in fact the body is not one member but many.

So he’s saying doesn’t matter the background doesn’t matter ethnicity. We come from different. Past and stories and families but God gives the spirit liberally to all and it comes out in different ways and we can sit there and compare and say you know you may someone could be prideful and think oh well I can do this in the church or I can do this spiritually so that makes me better or higher and God says no we all contribute. But now indeed there are many members yet one body and the eye cannot say to the hand I have no need of you nor again the head to the feet I have no need of you either no much rather those members of the body which seem to be weaker are necessary.

And those members of the body which we think to be less honorable. No on those we bestow greater honor and our unpresentable parts have greater modesty. And so true that is I think throughout my life. I have always been. Taught and um. Believed that every person adds even if it’s just a little thing we think it’s just a little thing every person adds and builds up the body and what we do here it’s it can’t just be done by one person and I never want to be in that position where I think oh I can do this now so I really made it no I I am a piece of this one body and I’m thankful for everyone who contributes.

And I never want to you know the these scriptures really just to me say we are called even though we are different and we have different expressions just like Isaac had different expression than his father and his son we are called to respect. Each other in those differences and not take each other for granted that is for sure so I just want to encourage you guys in that because it’s been racing through my mind in the last couple months it’s important to love and cherish each other’s differences. If you don’t know Stephanie and I are very close so I feel that that was directed toward me loving each other’s I’m just I’m joking got it it was it was very good um we’re all part of the body and we all need to contribute and we want to help each other out when I go home and the kids and you know I got I say okay it’s time to clean up it’s time to clear off the table it’s time to set the dinner table gotta feed the dog all these things you know if I’m only making brooklyn do everything that’s not fair right so we all contribute even erin she’ll get out there with the dog hi sadie.

scriptures.text_nkjv: But at midnight Paul and Silas were praying and singing hymns to God, and the prisoners were listening to them. Suddenly there was a great earthquake, so that the foundations of the prison were shaken; and immediately all the doors were opened and everyone’s chains were loosed. And the keeper of the prison, awaking from sleep and seeing the prison doors open, supposing the prisoners had fled, drew his sword and was about to kill himself. But Paul called with a loud voice, saying, “Do yourself no harm, for we are all here.”

faqs.answer: Members share songs, testimonies and scripture.

faqs.answer: Around the world in the military and at his job.

Was Isaac honored as a patriarch?
faqs.answer: Yes, God is called the God of Abraham, Isaac and Jacob.

faqs.answer: Do yourself no harm, we are all here.
